metadata.title: Misleading Food Labels: The Truth Behind ‘No Palm Oil’ Claims’
metadata.description:
#sponsored #paidvideo

Associations like Indian Food and Beverage Association and Oil Technologists' Association India says that ‘No Palm Oil’ written on food packets is often used as a marketing tactic, rather than a true indicator of better health.

Many consumers unknowingly trust these labels, so this video breaks down what studies actually say about palm oil. Understanding labels better can help families make smarter, science-backed decision about the
foods they buy.


#PalmOilFacts #FoodLabelAwareness #HealthyCookingOils #KnowWhatYouEat
#IndianFoodEducation #EdibleOilMyths
